disclaimer: Simplified estimate: 22% flat income tax on gross income. Estonia's basic exemption (up to €700/month, tapering to zero at higher incomes) is NOT included — the result may overstate tax for lower incomes. Employee unemployment insurance (1.6%) and pension (2%) are excluded.

regimes.label: Flat Income Tax (22%)
regimes.notes: Estonia's 22% rate applies after a tapering basic exemption. This simplified preset taxes gross income, so low-income results are conservative (slightly high).
